programmes.d: Both Light and Control emerge from their respective slumbers...
Ace realizes that her past actions need to be dealt with.
At Fetch Priory a mysterious skull is exerting a deadly influence on those around it.
The Doctor realizes the skull is an ancient horror from the mythology of his own people.
Stahl intends to control the power of the Fendahl for himself.
Thea has become the Fendahl Core and transforms everyone into Fendahleen.
The Doctor tries to prevent Professor Horner from breaking into an ancient barrow.
Devil's End is sealed off from the outside world by a heat barrier.
The Doctor attempts to help the Brigadier penetrate the heat barrier.
The Doctor is captured by the villagers who are under the Master's control.
UNIT have penetrated the heat barrier and launch an attack on the gargoyle, Bok.
(1/2) In Little Hodcombe, the townspeople are causing a dormant entity, the Malus, to re-awaken.
(2/2) Each of the TARDIS crew witnesses a terrifying apparition from the past.

The Doctor and Sarah take shelter in the castle of Dr Solon on the planet Karn.
The Doctor is a prisoner of the Sisterhood of Karn who plan to burn him at the stake.
Morbius demands that Solon install his brain in a new body.
The Doctor challenges Morbius to a mental duel in which only one of them will survive.
The Doctor and Leela are on Fang Rock island where a murderous creature is at large.
A thick fog surrounds Fang Rock as an alien menace stalks the island.
The survivors are in the lighthouse, but the Doctor is still worried about the creature.
The alien Rutan begins to pick off the remaining humans one by one.
The Doctor learns of the discovery of two alien seed pods in the Antarctic.
The Krynoid is on the loose in the Arctic.
The Doctor and Sarah track down the remaining Krynoid pod.
Keeler has been infected by the alien pod and is transforming into a Krynoid.
The Krynoid demands that the Doctor be surrendered to it.
The Doctor, Sarah and Scorby are hunted down by the mad Harrison Chase.
